content.description: Hydraulic circuit diagram showing the reverse (R) range configuration for the AA4DE automatic transmission. The diagram displays fluid flow paths marked in different colors (red, blue, yellow) representing different pressure circuits. It includes various hydraulic components such as valves, pistons, clutches, and accumulators with their interconnecting passages.
